description: Golden version-comparison pairs, generated from and asserted by desktop/test/version.test.js, and reproduced by the iOS client's Version.swift (mobile/ClawTests/VersionParityTests.swift). Each case is two versions and the sign of compare(a, b): -1 when a is older, 0 when equal, 1 when a is newer. isNewer(a, b) is compare(a, b) === 1. This is the comparison electron-updater delegates to semver on the desktop, pinned here so the phone's update check reaches the same answer without a second comparator.

cases.name: patch compares numerically, not as a string
a release outranks its own prerelease
a prerelease is below its release
a lower dev count is older whatever the sha
on a tie the sha orders lexically
a longer prerelease outranks a prefix of it
a numeric identifier ranks below a non-numeric one
a dirty build outranks the clean build of the same commit
the next patch dev build outranks the release it follows
a dev build is below the patch it is heading towards
